<!-- pr-reviewer: 50be729f8d4499860753c0d2d3b4fe05a3e848db -->
**Needs changes before merge** - one small blocker (PROCESS_VERSION); the code itself is clean.

## What looks good
- The move is faithful: the ten suites carry the same `#[test]` count (79 before in app). After: 78 in post plus the `ArcDto` test in app `float_roundtrip` (2 -> 3), and `vertical_arc_entry` split into post/motion halves under the same three names. Post's `inverted_post` gains the one new guard. Golden asserts are unchanged and no golden or snapshot PNG is touched.
- Every recorded input has a generator-side staleness guard (and an orphan check), and no `Cargo.toml` changed (no new dependency).
- No unwrap/expect outside test code; no product code changed; layering unchanged.

## Local results (PR head trial-merged with upstream/main 80a8deaf, clean merge)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (all suites, incl. the ten moved ones) | pass, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test vertical_arc_entry` | 3/3 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test float_roundtrip --test inverted_axis_display --test recorded_post_streams` | 3/3, 5/5, 5/5 |
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 87/87 |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings` | clean |

## Requested before merge
1. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`: the PR sets it to 32, but upstream main is now also at 32 (`e7d53147`), so after the merge there is no bump at all. This PR changes process files (`xtask/src/asset_tests.rs`, `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs`), so it must take the next number, 33 (AGENTS.md: whichever PR merges second takes the next number). Update the PR body's "PROCESS_VERSION 32" line too.

## Notes (not blocking)
- Body and commits otherwise fit the process (`Changelog: none`, `Fixes #926`, decisions file present). The PR's branch will need a merge of main when the bump is changed; the trial merge was clean.
- Overlap with #1034 is noted in the body; whichever merges second regenerates with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 045008b8c19b137158049cdc6c61d9c9175099cb -->
**Delta re-review: ready for the maintainer to merge.**

- Commits after 50be729f are two: a merge of upstream/main (81bb96e2, empty `--remerge-diff`, so no hand-resolved hunk) and 045008b8, which changes only `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 33, above upstream/main's 32; the PR body says "PROCESS_VERSION 33". The one needs-rework item is resolved.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 87 passed, 0 failed. `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: every suite binary ok, 0 failed. GitHub reports the PR MERGEABLE.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
